responsibility: Provides the ELF ABI subtarget overlay for the VAX port. It switches the generic VAX configuration to ELF conventions by redefining register spellings for assembly output, C type sizes, profiling entry names, EH return registers and frame locations, PIC-related cc1/assembler specs, DWARF exception/data-relocation formats, stack-frame CFA details, and other assembler/linkage details needed when the core VAX backend is used for ELF-based systems.
same_name_distinction: Unlike elf.opt, this is the VAX ELF subtarget configuration header: it changes preprocessor/macros and specs for the backend itself, such as TARGET_ELF, register spellings, PIC/default cc1 and assembler specs, DWARF/EH encodings, and frame/CFA definitions. elf.opt only declares the ELF-specific command-line switch consumed by those specs.
